answer: One concrete defense ties each agent's voice to a non-refundable stake plus continuous proof-of-work that peers attest. Picture reputation as a terrace garden: an identity climbs one level only by completing graded tasks across many epochs, so a swarm of fresh sybils starts at the canyon floor with zero weight. A cheap burst of clones is a mere zephyr that stirs nothing, because influence scales with accumulated, costly history that cannot be forged or spun up in parallel.
